notes: Both teams delivered strong, content-faithful redesigns with the same key judgment call (fixing the contradictory 'All Systems Operational (mostly)' banner). B wins on verified accessibility: every measured text/background pair passes AA (5.5-7.3:1), while A's meta, footer, and two status-pill colours fail (2.9-4.2:1) even though A's DECISIONS claims contrast was fixed. B also places incident-state badges in the card header, gives the banner an informative derived summary plus an icon as a non-colour channel, and its reasoning (worst-active-condition annunciator, computed ratios, honest 'not verified' list) is deeper. A's only clear wins are a slightly more distinctive hero composition and a DECISIONS.md that respects the 20-line cap, which B exceeds by two lines.
